scope: Candidate-only synthetic report-artifact storage adapter check using the opt-in report-export worker container and its writer credentials.
limitations: This exercised the S3-compatible artifact adapter in the candidate worker container; it did not execute the database-backed report worker or process a queued report request.

The probe created and deleted only one synthetic object; no report data was read or written.
